data.title: 长离 · 今州红绸的花嫁授课
data.description: 【今州山庭·清晨】长离穿着红白层叠婚纱站在山庭长廊，手中捧着凤凰羽毛与白花；她先向镜头伸出手示范一段礼仪步伐，再在花瓣落下时笑着收势，像把耐心也变成了誓约。
data.action: 山庭长廊示范一段礼仪步伐，花瓣落下时收势微笑
data.lighting: clear morning light on red railings
data.mood: 老师把耐心教成花嫁誓约
data.promptProse: Changli stands in the Jinzhou mountain corridor in her layered white-and-red phoenix wedding gown and light veil, holding white flowers and feather details beside the floral fan. She extends a hand to demonstrate a ceremonial step, then smiles as petals fall around her. The vertical medium-full view follows the red railing into the courtyard. Clear morning light illuminates embroidered phoenix edges and the offered palm, with railing shadows crossing the floor.
